propositions: An optional isolated adapter must parse pytest-cov coverage percentages from GitHub Actions run-log tails (word-boundary grep anchored to TOTAL line) and CI-health metrics (status, duration, red->green recovery interval) from run metadata.

A harvester script must pull recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the gh/Actions API, pass them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to the git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store (not the gitignored reports/ directory).

The core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) and the future metrics command must not import the github_actions adapter to maintain portability and ensure the CI workflow does not need permissions to commit snapshots.

The core command and workflow remain unchanged; snapshot harvesting is a separate optional script run locally or by a maintainer after CI completes, eliminating dependency on GHA's short log-retention window.
